title: The jury is still out.
text: I have a large dog-cat, meaning he acts like a dog trapped in a cat's body.  He doesn't knead, he barks at strangers, is afraid of heights, and hates boxes. But lately, his inner cat has been coming out. I decided to support the personality change and get him actual cat things.  Enter the kitnip box.  To my surprise, he showed no interest in the contents. I don't blame the company or the cat, it's just not love at first sight. My Maine coon-esk, monster of a ginger kitty/meow terrier just walked away. However, and this is the strange part, I can't find any of the toys now. They've all disappeared. I left the box open in reach of my kitty, though, and I did catch him playing catch with the catnip bag. I think I'm going to wait another month before deciding...
label: neutral
